id: title:estefaniarabadan:only supersede v3 runs with no recent loader progress

review.posthog_relevance: Checks warehouse import queue before superseding older runs, preserving batches still actively processed by a loader.
review.reason: Adds a stale-progress parameter and an EXISTS subquery to the SQL executed by warehouse import queue superseding, excluding batches whose state changed recently. P1.F1.H1: "        progress_stale_seconds: int = TAKEOVER_STALE_THRESHOLD_SECONDS," and "        AND b_live.state_changed_at > now() - make_interval(secs => %(progress_stale)s)".
